_comment: Real Jaskirat Rangi data (synthetic wealth client, Person Account) shaped to the clientProfileCard attribute contract. This is the payload a Custom Lightning Type renderer.json (Agentforce, flat $attrs.<field>) or MCP wrapper/payload CLT (nested outputValues.clientProfile.<field>) would map into the widget. Standard objects only: Account, AccountContactRelation, FinancialPlan, FinancialGoal, FinancialAccount, plus Case, Opportunity & PersonLifeEvent for the latent (payload-only) arrays. Covers the rendered sections, header, three KPIs (incl. computed netWorth), data-driven advisorSnapshot, goals (with color/url/captionLabel), and the accounts table (with type/url deep-links). The household/cases/opportunities/lifeEvents/allocation arrays are returned live in-org and omitted here rather than hand-authored. A reference snapshot, not a live capture; values may drift from the org.

attributes.advisorSnapshot: **Jaskirat Rangi** is a **High Net Worth** client managed by Raveesh Raina in the Rangi Household. Investable assets of **$2,150,000** against **$531,000** in mortgage debt put net investable worth near **$1,619,000**. Across 8 tracked goals, **Retirement Fund** is best funded at **33%**, while **Purchase Vacation Property** is furthest behind at **0%** and may warrant a funding conversation. Recent activity: **5** open opportunities in flight and a recent life event (**Retirement**, Feb 17, 2027). Review the allocation drift below before the next check-in.
attributes._goals_note: Apex sorts all tracked goals by funding fraction DESC and keeps the top 4 (goals with no target sink to the bottom); color = pct>=33 ? success : warning. Each goal also carries a url deep-link (omitted here).
attributes._accounts_note: Each account row also carries a url deep-link (base + /lightning/r/FinancialAccount/<id>/view), omitted here since ids are org-specific.
